about: Read by branch_gate.py, by the server's /api/reviews routes and by the task worker's reviews.land and branches.clean tasks. apply=false: the two tasks only report what they would do. lock: mock (the push check and the GitHub check say what they would refuse, print the advice and pass) or enforce. A branch with commits of its own lives unregistered_days after its last commit when it is registered to nobody and registered_days when it is registered to an account. A branch is cleanable when all of it is in the live source: what the repository's checkout has checked out, or its default branch on the remote. grace_days counts from when the cleaner first saw it so; a branch whose last commit is older than stale_days does not wait. worktree_idle_days: a side worktree idle this long, clean, and with its commit on the remote is removed from this computer with a notice of removal (branch_removed); the repository's own checkout is never touched. review_timeout_hours: an open change nobody objects to is accepted after this long. delete_after_landing: the default for a submitted change (the author may ask to keep the branch). protected: branch name patterns never cleaned, in every repository; a repository may add its own.
